landing.heroTitle: A quiet studio for your book
landing.heroSubtitle: Plan your plot, develop characters and world, write scenes, and get contextual AI help — in one calm space where you stay in control.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Your premise, facts, and manuscript no longer live in separate files. Move from idea to draft without extra cognitive load.
landing.feature_structure_desc: Parts, chapters, and scenes with ordering, statuses, and drag-and-drop.
landing.feature_characters_desc: Character cards linked to scenes — open them beside the editor.
landing.feature_world_desc: Project encyclopedia: places, rules, events, and notes.
landing.feature_plot_desc: Board, templates, and storylines — no mandatory methodology.
landing.feature_editor_desc: Autosave, focus mode, versions, and a context panel.
landing.feature_ai_desc: Analysis, questions, and editing — only with chosen context, never imposed.
landing.principle_author_desc: AI suggests options — you decide to accept, edit, or reject.
landing.principle_progressive_desc: Start with one scene or build structure first — both paths are equal.
landing.principle_context_desc: Characters, location, and scene goal — in a side panel, no screen switching.
landing.principle_calm_desc: Neutral background, clear typography, and minimal distractions for long sessions.
landing.principle_ownership_desc: Autosave, version history, and export to standard formats.
landing.ctaDesc: A working title is enough — add the rest as you go.
landing.ctaNote: Free sign-up. Your texts remain yours.
